mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( username, email, password, phone, profile_image, role, status, refresh, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{profileImage}, 'USER'#{role}, 'ACTIVE'#{userAccountStatus}, #{refreshToken}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.password, u.phone, u.profile_image, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.refresh, h.host_id, h.business_name, h.business_number, h.status AS host_registration_status FROM users u LEFT JOIN hosts h ON u.user_id = h.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
